title: China on $50 a Day: Real 2026 Prices | China Travel Expert
description:
How much does China actually cost in 2026? This is a real, itemized budget for the independent traveler — eSIM, payments, metro, street food, dorms, high-speed rail, and attractions — counted down to show how a full day lands comfortably under about $50 in second-tier cities, and stays doable in Beijing and Shanghai.

Every number here is a verified 2026 price with sources listed below. The biggest money mistake most first-timers make is on #2 (high-speed rail class), and the bonus at the end is the best free view in the country.

Chapters:
0:00 Intro — about $50 a day in China
1:15 #8 Get online (eSIM / SIM)
1:55 #7 Payments (Alipay / WeChat Pay)
2:35 #6 City transport (metro & bus)
3:20 #5 Food (street eats)
4:10 #4 Water & extras
4:50 #3 Where to sleep (hostel dorms)
5:45 #2 High-speed rail (the $50–100 mistake)
6:40 #1 Attractions
7:15 Bonus — the best free view in China

🧭 Expert Tip: Stay two or three metro stops from the #1 sight, not next to it — China's metro is so cheap that distance costs almost nothing and saves you real money every night.
